solution.text:
Re z
The modulus e ranges over all positive numbers, while the angle ranges strictly between
zero and 2π. This gives exactly the plane with the nonnegative real ray removed. Equal
exponentials have exponents differing by 2πik; two imaginary parts in this open interval
cannot differ by such a nonzero multiple, so the map is injective.
